page_title: BET 1-0 RAY | Betis v Rayo Vallecano 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Borja Iglesias (Betis) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90+2' That will be all from Isco who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sergi Altimira (Betis).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Borja Iglesias (Betis) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
88' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
87' The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.
87' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
86' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
85' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Marc Roca (Betis) for a tough tackle.
82' 5:6 – this is the current number of shots on target.
78' A substitution has been made. Randy Nteka is replaced by Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) is coming onto the pitch as Alfonso Espino cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' The attendance for today's match is 50619.
76' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Willian Jose and he is replaced by Borja Iglesias (Betis).
75' It's time for a substitution. Juan Cruz (Betis) comes on in place of Rodri.
70' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) smashes the ball towards goal with a volley from close-range, but the goalkeeper uses his incredible reflexes to make a brilliant save.
68' Willian Jose (Betis) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

67' A pass travels right across the box to Rodri (Betis) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Stole Dimitrievski denies him with a decent save.
65' Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
65' A cross into the box from Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
64' Francisco has decided to make a change. Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Pathe Ciss.
64' Today's match ends for Isi Palazon who will be replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
61' Luiz Felipe (Betis) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
61' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Rodri (Betis) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Raul de Tomas.
58' The main referee, Alejandro Ruiz, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) is given a yellow card for dissent.
58' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
57' Abner (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
55' That's a clear yellow card. Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) goes into the book.

53' 1 - 0 Willian Jose (Betis) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
52' A free kick on the edge of the box for Betis. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
52' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle after Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
51' Wow, what an escape. Willian Jose (Betis) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
50' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' The referee signals a corner kick to Betis.

47' OFF THE POST! Isco (Betis) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
46' Half-time substitution. Guido Rodriguez (Betis) will not participate anymore and Andres Guardado is coming on.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a half-time substitution. Abner (Betis) comes on in place of Juan Miranda.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' A free kick to Betis.
45+2' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul after Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) hacks down one of his opponents.
45' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) earns the yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The foul by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) was seen by Alejandro Ruiz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
43' What was Guido Rodriguez (Betis) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
41' Great save! Ayoze Perez (Betis) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Stole Dimitrievski.
38' Ayoze Perez (Betis) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies way over the bar.

38' Juan Miranda (Betis) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball has crossed the sideline. Betis are taking a throw-in.
37' Half-chance! Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) plays a pass into the box, but Rui Silva reacts well to snuff out the attack.
31' Flag goes up against Willian Jose (Betis) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
29' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rayo Vallecano was in an offside position.
27' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' A pass into the penalty area from Rodri (Betis) is intercepted by the defence.
20' Marc Roca (Betis) commits a foul and Alejandro Ruiz immediately signals a free kick.
18' The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
18' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.
16' The game is interrupted now, Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' Juan Miranda (Betis) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
14' Juan Miranda (Betis) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
14' The ball is cleared after Rodri (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' One of the players from Rayo Vallecano times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
11' Juan Miranda (Betis) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
9' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Silva, who smothers the ball.
5' Isco (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It's a throw-in for Rayo Vallecano.
4' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will take the free kick.
